limits: Object census shallow-size sums are not RSS, complete allocation measurements, or peak memory. Managed instance dictionaries and process globals are not fully represented.
Distinct-value counting hashes selected immutable values and can populate their existing hash caches.
Census forces one analysis worker; RSS runs use normal daemon worker selection.
Ten semantic warmup cycles prime all five fresh JSON oracles before RSS sampling; no cold oracle subprocess runs within the two measured memory phases.
RSS is from ps on a shared Mac; a stable bounded run does not prove absence of every leak.
Five edit timings are a regression observation, not a replacement for the previous twenty-sample performance experiment; one cold start cannot establish p95.
The earlier failed memory result used a different protocol and remains in performance-acceptance.json.
